references.text: The verse before, where the Lord tells Gideon that he will save Israel with the three hundred men who lapped water.
Gideon divides the three hundred men into three groups and gives them horns (shopharot) and jars with torches.
The three hundred men use the horns (shopharot) in battle against the Midianites.
The Midianite camp in the valley (the Jezreel Valley) is mentioned for the first time here.
The use of horns (shopharot) in war is also described at Jericho, where the Israelites used horns as a signal.
Saul also sent the people home to their tents after selecting a smaller force.
Gideon and the people camped by the spring of Harod, and the Midianite camp was north of them in the valley.
